blocks.text: The **Automated Store Management Platform** provides high-throughput retail operations, rapid product lookup, line-item invoicing, and cashier shift management. Engineered with **Quasar Framework (Vue 3)** and styled according to the **Lambda Design System**, the interface prioritizes speed, clarity, and ergonomics.
